kris.name: Missing security agent
kris.description: No Tenable agent, EDR, or AV is recorded for the asset.
kris.example: DC01 has no EDR/AV in the control portal.
kris.remediation: Deploy or repair the endpoint agent, verify telemetry, and record a time-bound exception if the platform cannot host one.
kris.action: Ticket to endpoint/security engineering; containment candidate when the asset is otherwise high-KRI.

kris.name: Stale control version
kris.description: Installed AV/EDR version is below the approved baseline.
kris.example: WS-FIN-042 AV is behind the approved baseline.
data_sources: approved baseline version in the control inventory
kris.remediation: Upgrade the control to the approved baseline and verify the reported version.
kris.action: Ticket to the endpoint owner; track to baseline within the control SLA.

kris.name: Stale threat feeds
kris.description: AV signature or EDR feed age exceeds the 24-hour SLA.
kris.example: WS-FIN-042 AV feed age is 11 days, above the 24-hour SLA.
data_sources: control inventory / EDR connector (EDR feed age)
kris.remediation: Restore feed connectivity, force an update, and treat detection as degraded until the feed is fresh.
kris.action: Ticket to endpoint/network engineering; compensating controls until fresh.

kris.name: Detect-only mode
kris.description: AV/EDR or application control is in monitor/detect mode instead of prevent/block.
kris.example: AV on WS-FIN-042 is in monitor mode, not prevent.
kris.remediation: Move the control to prevent/enforce after compatibility testing; document any exception.
kris.action: Ticket to the control owner; compensating controls while detect-only.

kris.name: Unresolved exploitable vulnerability
kris.description: The target CVE remains open on the asset and the finding carries exploit or patch signals that determine the interim control path.
kris.example: A CVE-scoped finding remains open on an asset while the scanner reports a patch available; the asset is still exposed until the patch is verified.
kris.remediation: Apply the vendor patch or the advisory's fixed version, then verify with a fresh scan. Use compensating controls only as an interim path.
kris.action: Patch path plus compensating controls; containment candidate; high KRI score.

kris.name: NAC non-compliant posture
kris.description: The NAC (Cisco ISE) policy reports the endpoint as non-compliant.
kris.example: ISE policy fails on DC01 and WS-FIN-042.
kris.remediation: Route to the remediation VLAN, fix the posture failure, and re-authorize.
kris.action: NAC containment candidate; requires the normal approval gates.

kris.name: Active compromise
kris.description: EDR reports an infection or a behavioral detection on the asset.
kris.remediation: Isolate and do not restore until the infection is cleared.

kris.name: Vulnerable runtime version
kris.description: A runtime product identified by CPE (for example PHP or Node.js) is inside the advisory's affected version range and below the fixed version, or is on an unsupported branch with no vendor fix.
kris.example: PHP 8.4.26 is below the fixed 8.4.27 for CVE-2026-109618; Node.js 22.22.0 is below 22.23.4 for CVE-2026-111497.
data_sources: verified advisory version ranges and fixed versions
kris.remediation: Upgrade the runtime to the advisory fixed version for the asset's branch, or apply the vendor's documented source backport; verify the reported version after the change.
kris.action: Patch path with the exact target version; if no vendor fix exists for the branch, compensating controls and a migration plan.

kris.name: Externally exposed vulnerable service
kris.description: The vulnerable finding is associated with a web listener (port/service) or an asset exposure score at/above the configured threshold.
kris.example: A PHP finding on TCP/443 with an asset exposure score of 850/1000.
kris.remediation: Reduce external exposure (WAF/IPS/firewall) while patching, then confirm the listener is no longer exposed to untrusted networks.
kris.action: Prioritize containment or WAF/IPS compensating controls; high KRI score.
